text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that the Three Goddesses? What am I doing here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I must be really exhausted… I'm just gonna take a little break.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know, I've never really looked closely at this statue…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, they've got the perfect selfie poses! That's the Goddesses for ya! Always on point!
